title: What Clients Notice.
intro: A quiet record of the experience — as shared by the families who trust us with their dogs.

items.quote: I recently adopted an 8-month-old Shih Tzu, and she can be a handful. Every time I try to brush her at home, she runs away, so I haven’t had much luck doing it myself. One of my clients recommended Penny, so I decided to give her a try. I was really impressed with how patient she was with my dog. Somehow Penny had her sitting there completely calm while she brushed her, which honestly surprised me because she never does that for me. Penny also took some time to show me the right way to brush her at home and gave me a few tips on taking care of her coat. I really appreciated that. She clearly knows what she’s doing and is very good with dogs. My dog looked great afterward and the whole experience was well worth the money. I’ll definitely be using Penny again.
